name: Pharma techno
author: Spectre
description: The pharmacy cross at 130 BPM: pulse, tunnel, arms chase, scanner, heartbeat, glitch, spinning plus.

name: Cross tunnel
author: Spectre
description: Flying down an endless plus-shaped tube, faster on the kick, four palettes.

name: Vicsek zoom
author: Spectre
description: The cross is the first step of the Vicsek fractal: an endless zoom into it.

name: Julia cross
author: Spectre
description: The Julia set of z^4 + c, a fractal shaped like a cross, breathing and morphing.

name: Mandala
author: Spectre
description: Polar plasma: waving petals, rings and crosses flowing out of the center.

name: Hypno spiral
author: Spectre
description: An endless zoom twisting into a spiral and back, round to cross and back.

name: Dream
author: Spectre
description: Breathing, crawling contour lines over drifting colors, like the walls on a trip.

name: Moire
author: Spectre
description: Op-art: interference patterns from five ring sources, boiling, inverted on the kick.

name: Hyper
author: Spectre
description: A tesseract and a 16-cell turning in four dimensions, phosphor trails, RGB glitches.

name: Hacker
author: Spectre
description: Bit streams rushing out along the arms, a glitching terminal in the center.

name: Outrun
author: Spectre
description: Synthwave: a striped sunset in the top arm, mountains, a neon grid racing below.

name: Dealer
author: Spectre
description: The pharmacy sign that sells the fun stuff: PHARMA turns DEALER, the menu, the clock stuck at 04:20.

name: No health
author: Spectre
description: The pharmacy that doesn't want your health: heart rate through the roof, acid smiley, side effects.

name: Cross heartbeat
author: Spectre
description: The green cross beating like a heart, waves flowing out.

name: Cross rings
author: Spectre
description: Rainbow crosses zooming out forever.

name: Plasma
author: Spectre
description: The demoscene classic, a seamless loop.

name: Rainbow tunnel
author: Spectre
description: A striped tunnel, a seamless loop.

name: Analog clock
author: Spectre
description: A round face with hands and a smooth second hand, the time and date beside it.

name: Binary clock
author: Spectre
description: Each digit of HH MM SS as a column of four lights: add up the lit ones.

name: Digital clock
author: Spectre
description: Big hours and minutes, the date, the seconds as a bar; the color follows the time of day.

name: Word clock
author: Spectre
description: The time in words, to the nearest five minutes (English or French).

name: Countdown
author: Spectre
description: Days, then hours, minutes and seconds to a date you set in the script; it celebrates at zero.

name: How far along
author: Spectre
description: The day, the week, the month and the year, as progress bars.

name: Comets
author: Spectre
description: Bouncing dots with fading trails; on the cross they bounce off the arms and corners.

name: Fire
author: Spectre
description: Flames rising from the bottom.

name: Space invaders
author: Spectre
description: Marching invaders and a cannon shooting back.

name: Kaleidoscope
author: Spectre
description: Ribbons mirrored eight ways, fading out.

name: Lava
author: Spectre
description: Two layers of smooth noise turned into hot colors.

name: Lissajous
author: Spectre
description: A point tracing curves that slowly change shape, with a fading trail.

name: Metaballs
author: Spectre
description: Blobs of light merging and splitting like a lava lamp.

name: RGB moire
author: Spectre
description: Three sets of rings, red, green and blue, wandering and interfering.

name: Zone plate
author: Spectre
description: Rings closer and closer to the edges: ghost circles appear where the LEDs can't follow.

name: Qix
author: Spectre
description: Lines gliding and swirling with a trail, after the arcade classic.

name: Digital rain
author: Spectre
description: Green streams falling down each column.

name: Rotozoom
author: Spectre
description: A checkerboard turning and zooming, the demoscene classic.

name: Starfield
author: Spectre
description: Flying through space, stars streaming out from the center.

name: Tunnel
author: Spectre
description: Flying down an endless striped tube.

name: Matrix rain
author: Spectre
description: Green drops falling with bright heads and fading tails.

name: Rainbow
author: Spectre
description: A rainbow scrolling across the panel: the smallest script.

name: Shapes
author: Spectre
description: A radar sweep, a spinning triangle, bouncing circles, a breathing frame.

name: Spirograph
author: Spectre
description: A spirograph drawn a few lines at a time, a new one every ten seconds.

name: Bouncing balls
author: Spectre
description: Gravity, bounces off the walls and off each other; on the cross they rest on the arms.

name: Boids
author: Spectre
description: A flock of birds keeping together; the color shows where each one heads.

name: Langton's ants
author: Spectre
description: Three ants flipping cells: chaos, then highways.

name: Game of Life
author: Spectre
description: Conway's cells, born bright and calming down; restarts when it gets stuck.

name: Double pendulum
author: Spectre
description: Two arms, gravity, chaos, and a fading rainbow trail.

name: Falling sand
author: Spectre
description: Colored grains pouring and piling up; on the cross they fill the arms.

name: Spectrum bars
author: Spectre
description: The sound's spectrum as bars, a flash on the beat. Needs the matrix's microphone.

name: Equalizer
author: Spectre
description: Hi-fi bars from green to red with slowly falling peaks. Needs the matrix's microphone.

name: Sound fireworks
author: Spectre
description: Each beat bursts a rocket of sparks. Needs the matrix's microphone.

name: Sound history
author: Spectre
description: The sound scrolling by like a track's waveform. Needs the matrix's microphone.

name: Bass plasma
author: Spectre
description: Plasma dancing to the bass: faster and brighter when it hits. Needs the matrix's microphone.

name: Beat rings
author: Spectre
description: Each beat sends a ring of color out from the center. Needs the matrix's microphone.

name: Sound sun
author: Spectre
description: Rays all around, one per frequency band, slowly turning. Needs the matrix's microphone.

name: Beat word
author: Spectre
description: A word that jumps on every beat. Needs the matrix's microphone.

name: Spectrogram
author: Spectre
description: Time scrolls up, bass on the left, loud is hot. Needs the matrix's microphone.

name: Oscilloscope
author: Spectre
description: The microphone's waveform. Needs the matrix's microphone.

name: Text scroll
author: Spectre
description: A message scrolling across in rainbow letters: change the text in the script.

name: Hello World
author: Spectre
description: Hello World in rainbow colors: a first script to start from.

name: Hello console
author: Spectre
description: Prints to the app's console (Code editor), nothing on the matrix: printBLE for debugging.
